scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js init
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/sites packages/companion packages/cli && npm run build -w @ezapply/extension && npm run build -w @ezapply/ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/sites packages/companion packages/cli && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck -w @ezapply/engine && npm run typecheck -w @ezapply/sites && npm run typecheck -w @ezapply/extension && npm run typecheck -w @ezapply/ui
